posts.title: I had no idea Spotify's limiter sounded so BAD...
posts.description: I've known about Spotify's limiter for years. Here's the funny thing, though - I never really listened to it... until now. At first, they applied it to everything – which was bad. Then, they switched it off, which was better - unless you were a subscriber and had chosen the "Loud" option in the preferences. […]
